    <script><![CDATA[
    try {
      // 更新原请假记录
      var leaveRecord = new GlideRecord('x_1973840_leave_request');
      if (leaveRecord.get(current.original_leave_request)) {
        var newCancelledHours = parseFloat(leaveRecord.cancelled_hours || 0) + parseFloat(current.cancel_hours);
        leaveRecord.cancelled_hours = newCancelledHours;
        leaveRecord.remaining_hours = parseFloat(leaveRecord.leave_hours) - newCancelledHours;
        leaveRecord.update();
      }
      
      // 如果是年假类型，扣除年假额度
      if (leaveRecord.leave_type == 'annual') {
        var currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
        
        // 查找员工当年的年假记录
        var annualLeaveRecord = new GlideRecord('x_1973840_leave_employee_annual_leave');
        annualLeaveRecord.addQuery('employee', current.caller_id);
        annualLeaveRecord.addQuery('year', currentYear);
        annualLeaveRecord.addQuery('active', true);
        annualLeaveRecord.query();
        
        if (annualLeaveRecord.next()) {
          var newUsedHours = parseFloat(annualLeaveRecord.used_hours || 0) + parseFloat(current.cancel_hours);
          var remainingHours = parseFloat(annualLeaveRecord.total_hours) - newUsedHours;
          
          if (remainingHours < 0) {
            gs.warn('员工年假不足！当前剩余: ' + annualLeaveRecord.remaining_hours + '小时，需要扣除: ' + current.cancel_hours + '小时');
          }
          
          annualLeaveRecord.used_hours = newUsedHours;
          annualLeaveRecord.remaining_hours = remainingHours;
          annualLeaveRecord.update();
          
          // 更新销假记录的扣除信息
          current.annual_leave_deducted = current.cancel_hours;
          current.deduction_processed = true;
        }
      }
      
      gs.info('销假申请 ' + current.number + ' 已获批准，年假已扣除');
    } catch (e) {
      gs.error('处理销假批准时发生错误: ' + e.message);
    }
  ]]></script>
    <sys_policy/>
    <template/>
    <when>after</when>
  </sys_script>
</record_update>
